title: What does the South make of the King of the North?
summary: New UK PM Andy Burnham begins his tenure as prime minister, with BBC South gathering public reaction to his first week in office. The coverage reflects early public sentiment toward the new leadership during this transition period.
content: BBC South has been hearing from people about new PM Andy Burnham's first week in the top job.

zh.title: 南方如何看待北方之王？
zh.summary: 新任英国首相安迪·伯纳姆开始了他的首相任期，BBC南部频道收集了公众对其上台第一周的反应。这份报道反映了过渡时期公众对新领导层的早期看法。

title: 'We feel the pressure juggling holiday logistics'
summary: UK parents report increasing pressure managing summer holidays due to rising childcare costs, limited unpaid leave, and inadequate support for children with special educational needs. These systemic challenges create significant financial and logistical burdens for families during the school break.
content: Parents say childcare costs, unpaid leave and SEND support gaps make summer holidays harder

zh.title: 我们感受到管理假期日程的压力
zh.summary: 英国父母报告说，由于托儿成本上升、无薪假期有限以及对有特殊教育需求儿童的支持不足，管理暑假的压力日益增加。这些系统性挑战在学校假期期间为家庭造成了重大的经济和物流负担。

title: Finland’s radical answer to renewable energy’s biggest headache: The world’s largest sand battery
summary: A Finnish municipality deployed the world's largest commercial sand battery to address intermittency, one of renewable energy's critical challenges. Sand batteries store thermal energy and could become crucial infrastructure for stabilizing renewable energy supply.
content: A small Finnish town has turned to the world's largest commercial sand battery to tackle a major hurdle in the energy transition: intermittency.

zh.title: 芬兰应对可再生能源最大难题的激进方案：世界上最大的沙电池
zh.summary: 芬兰一个城市部署了世界上最大的商业沙电池，以解决可再生能源的关键挑战之一——间歇性问题。沙电池存储热能，可能成为稳定可再生能源供应的关键基础设施。

title: SpaceX launches massive Starship rocket in first test flight since IPO
summary: SpaceX has launched its massive Starship rocket in its first test flight following the company's recent IPO. The milestone marks a significant step forward for Elon Musk's rocket maker in developing its next-generation launch vehicle.
content: Elon Musk's rocket maker is conducting the first test fight for its massive Starship rocket since the company's IPO last month.

zh.title: SpaceX在IPO后首次试飞中发射大型星舰火箭
zh.summary: SpaceX在公司最近上市后进行了大型星舰火箭的首次试飞。这一里程碑标志着埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司在开发下一代运载火箭方面迈出了重要一步。

title: Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect, as experts say they may not hold up
summary: President Donald Trump has announced new tariffs, including 25% duties on Brazilian imports and planned 50% tariffs on Canadian goods. Legal challenges have already been filed against the tariffs, with experts questioning their legal viability.
content: President Donald Trump has renewed a flurry of tariffs, including slapping 25% duties on Brazilian imports and vowing 50% tariffs on goods from Canada.

zh.title: 新关税生效数小时后特朗普被起诉，专家称其可能站不住脚
zh.summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布了新的关税，包括对巴西进口商品征收25%的关税以及计划对加拿大商品征收50%的关税。已经对这些关税提出了法律诉讼，专家对其法律可行性提出质疑。
